The main takeaway from our work is that
hypergraph partitioning can be used to efficiently partition sparse tensor operations in distributed memory systems, which is an important step towards efficient tensor-based data mining algorithms.
a careful task definition and a proper partitioning of the tasks is crucial in order to achieve scalability in distributed memory sparse tensor decomposition algorithms.
